olivia: opening a tiny PR to add a 'quick migration' note for Optimize toolkit: continuous batching + prefix KV cache + recommended quant profiles. need a short runnable Python snippet and one reviewer. @noah?
noah: I can review. keep it super short and copy/pasteable for SDK v0.8. add a one-line 'when not to use' note.
olivia: here's the snippet (15 lines):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(
  model="optimize/interactive-v1",
  input="Summarize recent messages",
  batching={"mode":"continuous","batch_window_ms":20},
  cache={"enable_prefix_kv":True,"ttl_seconds":300},
  quant_profile="latency-8bit"
)
print(resp.text)
```
kai: add a tiny warmup tip: prefill one short prompt to prime KV before heavy traffic. also suggest a fallback to compact-6bit under contention.
olivia: added warmup + fallback sentence. also added a docs-ci snippet test that runs the snippet with a mocked endpoint to prevent regressions.
